Name: Super Short Grass
Author: joyous1ariella
Description:
EDIT: Sorry that the Nexus bugged out when I wrote the description lol. Should be fixed now!

Tired of losing your smol livestock in the tall grass?
ME TOO!
So I made the grass super short.

It's worth noting that this makes it look rather sparse, but I'm ok with that since I only use it to feed my babies anyway.

Enjoy!
-Ariella

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley game folder and go to the Content--->TerrainFeatures folder (mine is at C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\TerrainFeatures)
[*]MAKE A COPY OF grass.xnb FOR BACKUP!
[*]Extract the .rar to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program and overwrite the file.
[/list]
